# d100 Road Encounter Table — The Mireward Reach
**Then:** Ask the table **where they want the camera first** — camp, the line, Lysandra, the fire, Ephanna’s departure — and run from there.
Some things I want them to encounter while traveling are deserted towns, that look like they were abandoned in a rush.

Lets start with an brainstorming idea dump, not everything here works, this is just ideas. I don't want model assistance here, I want to have my unrefined prose stored and flagged as brainstorming.  This is prep for Longmont Campaign 2 Session 21
**After major cult confrontation (prep outro, same file):**

- Delivers **deed to Wolf’s Estate** to the party; treats them as a **stoic, duty-bound** ally. - **Formal patron of the party’s deputy status** — watches outcomes carefully; deputizes them to **investigate cult / Shepherd’s Flock** threats with official leverage.

| Age / year | Beat | |------------|------| | **Child** | Learns head-count at tithe scale from **Torr**; **Lysandro’s** wall walk; **toll protest picnics** (family **brings stew** to protesters **and** guards). | | **~15** | Charter youth militia — family **approves** (“**people’s** wall”). First kiss with **Delwen** at ferry steps; Merrow **already** planning mock reeve speech. | | **~17** | Real fight at **tithe barn overflow** — Lysandra **de-escalates** without crown backup; **Thalia Ashenvale** (Mirathorn Guard, north recruitment ride) **notices**. | | **~19** | Leaves for Mirathorn “**one season**” — training intake. Delwen **waves every ferry day** for a month. | | **~20–24** | Stays

- Storm fronts made the first march day tense; we need to plan the next weather roll beat for Session 23. - Hester Mull appeared as a courier encounter; unresolved whether the party trusts the detour offer.

Karsemine, always keeping a sharp eye on her surroundings, is the first to notice something just off the trail. She picks up an iridescent scale, still warm to the touch. She shows it to Caelynn to make an arcana check, but she can’t tell anything about it. As the group continues up the path the number of scales laying around continues to grow until it becomes obvious something is up ahead. Karsemine becomes very nervous about reaching the top and finding something waiting. While Caelynn creates Good Berries for everyone, Karemine scouts ahead.
